generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: approval concept sheet for sculpted 3D shogi miniature characters, not final playable 3D files.
Primary request: Create an exquisitely detailed sculpted miniature shogi army with eight clearly distinct Japanese figures, late Sengoku / Azuchi-Momoyama inspired circa 1580–1600. Historical clothing and weapon construction, artistic mapping of shogi roles. Realistic human proportions adapted subtly for legibility at tabletop scale, convincing tiny painted sculptures rather than illustration or flat tokens. All figures on small forward-pointing pentagonal dark wood bases.
Composition: large landscape contact sheet on neutral warm gray studio background, two rows of four individually separated full-body three-quarter miniature renders, all feet, weapons and bases fully visible. Consistent scale and lighting. Simple small English labels directly under each figure, exactly: top row KING, GOLD, SILVER, KNIGHT; second row LANCE, PAWN, ROOK, BISHOP. One thin bottom strip shows three additional action studies with labels SWORD, SPEAR, MATCHLOCK.
Subjects:
KING: Japanese court sovereign in layered ochre formal sokutai robes with traditional black kanmuri court headgear and a shaku tablet, ceremonial sword sheathed at side, dignified upright silhouette, no European crown.
GOLD: senior armored warrior commander in black lacquered late 16th century gusoku with restrained gold details, plausible kabuto, sword, solid protective stance.
SILVER: lighter armored agile swordsman in dark indigo textile and iron-gray armor plates, curved Japanese sword drawn in low guard, clearly different helmet and silhouette from gold.
KNIGHT: compact mounted samurai on a small realistically proportioned Japanese horse with period saddle and tack, rider's sword ready, all four hooves within a compact base footprint, no gigantic European horse.
LANCE: ashigaru spearman with a long straight-bladed yari, simple iron jingasa and practical body armor, vertical spear in idle stance.
PAWN: plainly equipped foot soldier with simple jingasa, cloth leggings, modest cuirass, short yari held at side, simpler and shorter silhouette than lance.
ROOK: matchlock marksman with wood-stock Japanese tanegashima matchlock, visible serpentine match holder, simple jingasa and dark lacquer cuirass, weapon held safely upward for idle miniature.
BISHOP: armored Japanese bowman with asymmetric yumi bow, arrow quiver, indigo and muted brown clothing, no religious robes or European bishop hat.
Action strip: same GOLD performing a convincing two-handed downward sword cut; same LANCE delivering a two-handed long spear thrust; same ROOK kneeling and firing a matchlock with brief warm muzzle flash and small white smoke plume. Action poses are animation keyframe concepts, not extra classes. No gore.
Materials: tiny tactile sculpted details, visible lacing, lacquer sheen, silk folds, dull iron, worn wood, restrained gold, natural skin. Black lacquer and indigo unify army; no oversized fantasy pauldrons, no magic, no modern firearms, no neon, no chibi faces, no European armor, no flat illustrated cutouts.
Lighting: soft studio key light, readable shadows, restrained realistic PBR rendering. Clean approval sheet, each character clearly readable.
